PLATE 01 — PROFILE

About

SCALE 1:1
REV A

I'm Mathew, a BSCS student based in Batangas who likes turning plain requirements into working software. My most recent build is a Flask-based clinic management system for a speech delay clinic — a role-based platform for admins, therapists, clients, and patients.

On that project I added a full patient portal with appointment booking and approval flows, plus a medical records module with staff editing and read-only patient access — the kind of feature work that has to be both secure and easy to use.

Outside of coursework, I keep showing up to seminars and conferences — research methodology, data, AI, and analytics — to stay a step ahead of the syllabus.
